violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken and raw pork were being stored over milk, coleslaw and tomato salsa in the 2DR prep top cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS NEED TO BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS IN ORDER TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF BACTERIA. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE RAW CHICKEN AND PORK TO BELOW THE MILK, COLESLAW AND TOMATO SALSA THAT ARE IN THE 2DR PREP TOP COOLER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Coleslaw for pupusas was being stored on the floor after preparation.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOOD CAN NEVER BE STORED ON THE FLOOR AND MUST BE AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE COLESLAW TO A SHELF IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR, OFF OF THE FLOOR.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs were being stored above washed and prepared produce in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY RAW FOODS CAN NOT BE STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE RAW SHELL EGGS BELOW THE WASHED AND PREPARED PRODUCE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. COOKED BEEF ON THE BONE WAS TEMPING AT 49F IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AFTER BEING COOKED OVER 12 HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EHS DISCUSSED THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS WITH PIC. PIC THREW COOKED BEEF ON BONE AWAY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: shredded lettuce(52F); cream based coleslaw(51F); coleslaw for pupusas (57F) in the 2DR prep top unit were not temping properly.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS NEED TO BE AT A MAXIMUM OF 41F. PIC EXPLAINED TO EHS THAT FOODS IN THE PREP TOP COOLER WERE ONLY PUT THERE 2 HOURS PRIOR. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE ALL FOODS BEING STORED IN THE BOTTOM OF THE PREP TOP COOLER BACK TO THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AND HAD EMPLOYEE PLACE ALL TCS FOODS STORED IN THE TOP OF THE PREP TOP COOLER ON ICE.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Non-Commercial Juice, Warning Label Not Pasteurized
violations.observation: Untreated juice packaged in the food establishment is not labeled with a proper warning statement.
violations.corrective_action: Juice packaged in a food establishment, if not treated to attain a 5-log reduction of the most resistant microorganism of public health significance, shall be labeled with a warning notice that states 'WARNING: This product has not been pasteurized and, therefore, may contain harmful bacteria that can cause serious illness in children, the elderly, and persons with weakened immune systems'. EHS WILL PROVIDE GUIDANCE ON STICKERS FOR JUICE THAT IS NOT PASTEURIZED. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE BEGIN LABELING ORANGE JUICES IN 2DR GLASS SLIDING COOLER NEAR CASH AS “NOT PASTEURIZED” UNTIL THEY GET PROPER LABELS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Raw whole chicken sitting in a water bath at 3 vat sink to thaw.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE 3 PROPER WAYS TCS FOODS CAN BE THAWED. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE WHOLE CHICKENS TO WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO FINSIH PROPERLY THAWING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2DR prep top cooler is temping at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC WILL HAVE UNIT SERVICED BEFORE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
